arStrings.szText:
"I saw a holy oxen shimmering in the fires of the Eternal Grazing,
His eyes reflected the truth: the Pasture can never be saved,

"Then came a thousand discordant voices, whispering of a realm that did not exist,
And after untold ages, the king who was bound in a harness was set free."
"Tears of milk rained on distant isles, and the door of the dead was opened,

"A father, mother, and child burned on a pyre, and their ashes fell upon a bog,
I saw a bovine carcass, and from its mouth crawled a magpie,
"I saw an orphan become a lord, and his hoofsteps led the way to destiny,
